reviews.text: We are very pleased with our new Providence Custom Pool. From start to finish, step by step, the construction was seamless. Paul was there every step of the way answering all our questions, excellent communication. Best part... we were done in under 30 days. We highly recommend using Providence Custom Pool.
reviews.author: C D

reviews.text: We had a vision and Paul brought it to life. The 6” splash deck is perfect for laying out or entertaining the grandkids. Start to finish this pool was complete in about a month. This is the second pool Providence Custom Pools has done for us and we will continue to refer them to anyone looking for an honest, dependable builder!
reviews.author: Jennifer Becherer

reviews.text: Paul was excellent in working with us on design, particularly with changes as they occurred. The finished project turned out exactly as we expected and from start to finish took 30 days. Constant comments from guests on how much they loved how it turned out.
reviews.author: Mel Ray

reviews.text:
Paul Perry built our pool and we had a wonderful experience! He was excellent in every aspect. From drawing the plans to coordinating subs, he was on top of it all and communicated with us every step. If we needed anything or had questions Paul was always quick to respond to our calls/ messages. Even after the pool has been complete he has still helped us with learning curves we have had. Our pool is beautiful and exactly what we wanted. He walked us through all the different options and helped us decide what was best for our project. He truly can design whatever you envision for your space.  Timeframe was also impressive, from dig to done was about 1 month (March 2023- April 2023).
Also worth noting, that all subs who were sent to our home were very respectful and great as well. If you are looking for a very knowledgeable pool builder who also has integrity and great communication, Paul is your guy. We would highly recommend Paul for anyone’s pool project.
reviews.author: Kristina Ashmore

reviews.text: We used Providence Custom Pools to build our first pool.  We didn’t really know much about pools, but had an idea of what we want.  Paul helped us design and get the pool that we enjoy.  He was honest in his experience of things that work and don’t.  As well as keeping our budget in mind.  Any time we needed anything, he would always get us the info we needed.  We would recommend them again if we were to ever build another pool.  We highly recommend Providence Custom Pools.
reviews.author: Melissa Silva

reviews.text: Paul Perry was the designer and general contractor for our project, which was to redesign our entire back yard!  This included the beautiful pool, huge concrete patio with 3 sets of lighted stairs, huge covered pavilion, and three garden areas.  Paul was very responsive to all our requests and questions, was on site daily.  The contractors worked efficiently together to get the job done without delays!  Definitely will work with Paul again, if we have the need, recommend him highly!
reviews.author: Joan Novinsky

reviews.text: Paul built our pool and installed our backyard pergola. We recommend his company 100%!!! He is an honest man with integrity and that is something money cannot buy! We are extremely grateful for his work. Glad we chose him over all these others because of the ease of reaching him and not having to call a “customer service” line to put in a “ticket” for every request. Paul talked us through every phase and stage of the build. He made great recommendations relevant for our family. He was very hands on and would come by himself each time after something was completed to inspect and tidy up. The personal touch was amazing! It felt like having a dad or uncle build for us but with professionalism. From breaking ground to completion took 66 days. This was in 2020 and included slight delay with the gunite phase. He kept us updated throughout. When we need other things done in our backyard, he recommended a great company and we dealt with them directly (he could have been a middle man but he didn’t which saved us money). Recommend this company over all others we got quotes from.
reviews.author: Victoria R

reviews.text: Paul did a great job with our pool.  He worked with us on a custom design and carried it out.  We've enjoyed our pool for many summers thanks to Paul
reviews.author: M P

data.summary: The 11 Google reviews are highly detailed, specific, and appear authentic from genuine customers. The perfect 5.0 score with low volume is more indicative of a small, well-regarded business than manipulation. The lack of any negative reviews or complaints is notable but plausible for a boutique contractor.
fake_signals: Two reviews posted same day (3 weeks ago)
authentic_signals: Specific project details (Providence Custom Pool, 6” splash deck)
Varied writing styles and specific praise points
Mention of repeat business (second pool built)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only significant review data is from Google, which shows a perfect 5.0 rating. No contradictory ratings from other platforms were found.
